description: This file defines the PersonService interface in a Spring Boot application, which declares methods for managing Person entities including fetching, retrieving by ID, adding, updating, and deleting persons.

classes.name: PersonService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to manage Person entities within the application.

methods.name: fetchPersonsByPages
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Person objects based on the given page number and size.

methods.name: getPersonById
methods.description: Fetches a Person entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: addPerson
methods.description: Adds a new Person entity to the system.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates an existing Person entity identified by the given ID.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Removes a Person entity from the system based on its ID.
